aide_memoire_puerto_rico:
Reference

Puerto Rico 1897 on one page

Round · Roles · Setup · Prices · End · Buildings

A round

  1. The Governor chooses a role, acts with the advantage, then everyone performs the action clockwise.
  2. The next player chooses another role, and so on: one role each (three each with two players).
  3. End of the round: 1 coin on each role not chosen, the roles come back, the Governor card passes to the left.

The roles

RoleAction for allAdvantageRemember
f_fruits_m_mais:
F = Fruit, C = Corn, in order from the Governor. With two players: 1 of each Commercial Building and 2 of each Production Building; 3 tiles of each Countryside type and 2 barrels of each Good removed.

Prices and discounts

Good
carrieres_occupees_peso_chacune:
Occupied Quarries: −1 coin each, at most 1 (top section), 2 (second), 3 (third), 4 (Large Buildings). Builder: −1. Never below 0.

Game end

At the end of the round in which: the supply cannot refill the Work Register, or a player has filled all 12 City spaces, or the last VP chip is taken. Score = VP chips + Building VP + bonuses of occupied Large Buildings. Tie: coins + barrels.

Buildings

In board order, section by section; Expansion I at the end, by cost.
